datasets.name: jsondoc
datasets.sql:
select 
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.id,'[^][,]+', 1, level) id,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.amount,'[^][,]+', 1, level) amount,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.duration,'[^][,]+', 1, level) duration,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.purpose,'[^][,]+', 1, level) purpose,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.loanType,'[^][,]+', 1, level) loantype,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.status,'[^][,]+', 1, level) status,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.offerDate,'[^][,]+', 1, level) offerdate,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.interestRate,'[^][,]+', 1, level) interestRate,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.commission,'[^][,]+', 1, level) commission,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.offerAmount,'[^][,]+', 1, level) offerAmount,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.offerDuration,'[^][,]+', 1, level)  offerDuration,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.offerGracePeriod,'[^][,]+', 1, level) offerGracePeriod,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.taxesStatus,'[^][,]+', 1, level) taxesStatus,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.bankStatus,'[^][,]+', 1, level) bankStatus,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.edfStatus,'[^][,]+', 1, level) edfStatus,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.submittedDate,'[^][,]+', 1, level) submittedDate,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.gracePeriod,'[^][,]+', 1, level) gracePeriod,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.id,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_id,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.tin,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_tin,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.companyName,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_companyName,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.registrationForm,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_registrationForm,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.serialNumber,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_serialNumber,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.pin,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_pin,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.incorporationDate,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_incorporationDate,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.legalAddress,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_legalAddress,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.company.actualAddress,'[^][,]+', 1, level) company_actualAddress,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.stakeholders.id,'[^][,]+', 1, level) stakeholders_id,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.stakeholders.tin,'[^][,]+', 1, level)stakeholders_tin,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.stakeholders.fullName,'[^][,]+', 1, level) stakeholders_fullName,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.stakeholders.contactNumber,'[^][,]+', 1, level) stakeholders_contactNumber,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.stakeholders.email,'[^][,]+', 1, level) stakeholders_email,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.document.id,'[^][,]+', 1, level)document_id,
regexp_substr(a.data.applications.document.fileName,'[^][,]+', 1, level) document_filename,
a.data.lastPageNumber lastPageNumber from json_documents a 
connect by regexp_substr(a.data.applications.id, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null
